comments.body:
This quest is in the retail release, I just completed it. The trick is that it's only available after you finish [b]The Perfect Stout[/b]. The problem is that the quest giver for [b]Rejold's New Brew[/b] is Tharek Blackstone, who's in Kharanos. The other problem is that right after you complete [b]The Perfect Stout[/b] in Brewnall Village, you are asked to do [b]Shimmer Stout[/b].

[b]Rejold's New Brew[/b] directly leads to [b]Shimmer Stout[/b], so if you accept [b]Shimmer Stout[/b] upon completing [b]The Perfect Stout[/b] (as presumably most people do) you won't be offered [b]Rejold's New Brew[/b].

So, if you really want to do [b]Rejold's New Brew[/b], you must do the following:

1. Complete [b]The Perfect Stout[/b] in Brewnall Village.

2. Decline the offer to start [b]Shimmering Stout[/b] (in Brewnall Village).

3. Head to Kharanos and talk to Tharek Blackstone. He's right outside of the blacksmithing building.

Tharek will offer you [b]Rejold's New Brew[/b], then you can head back to Brewnall Village whereupon [b]Rejold's New Brew[/b] will lead automatically to [b]Shimmering Stout[/b].

I still had [b]Shimmer Stout[/b] when I saw this thread. I abandoned the quest and was able to get the quest [b]Rejold's New Brew[/b]. After completion I was then able to get the quest [b]Shimmer Stout[/b].

It's a tricky sequence, but to get this quest you hvae to turn down [b]Shimmer Stout[/b] which is offered upon completing [b]The Perfect Stout[/b]. Then you have to go to Kharanos and talk to Tharek (who's right outside the blacksmithing building) and obtain this quest.

If you accept [b]Shimmer Stout[/b] before taking this, you'll never be offered this quest because it's a prerequisite for [b]Shimmer Stout[/b].

So the proper quest order is:

1. [b]The Perfect Stout[/b] (Brewnall Village)
2. [b]Rejold's New Brew[/b] (Kharanos)
3. [b]Shimmering Stout[/b] (Brewnall Village)
